name: Noah Williams
headline: Backend Engineer
summary: Backend engineer with 6 years on logistics and energy platforms: Python 3 services, Postgres, k8s, and the occasional ML model when the data supports one.

experience.title: Senior Backend Engineer
bullets: Rebuilt the shipment-tracking service in FastAPI on Python 3.12, now ingesting 40M carrier events a day.
Tuned Postgres indexes and partitioning, cutting p95 query latency from 900 ms to 85 ms.
Run 30 services on k8s with Kustomize overlays and horizontal pod autoscaling; zero unplanned downtime in 2025.
Shipped an ETA-prediction ML model built with sklearn and served it behind the tracking API.

experience.title: Backend Developer
bullets: Built RESTful APIs in Python 3 for smart-meter billing across 220,000 households.
Designed the Postgres schema for tariff versioning, removing a whole class of back-billing errors.
Wrote JS dashboards for the operations team on top of the billing APIs.
Containerised nightly reporting jobs with Docker and moved them from cron boxes to Amazon Web Services.
